description:
Problem. #2797 pinned the SHA-256 of https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh in the four "Install muse" steps of .github/workflows/oracle-review-shadow.yml (`MUSE_INSTALLER_SHA256`, checked with `test "$(sha256sum ...)" = ...`). That file is only a bootstrap. It downloads https://api.meta.ai/muse-launcher.sh, checked only against an `x-content-sha256` header from the same server and skipped when the header is absent. The launcher then reads the `muse-stable` channel and downloads whatever binary version is current from lookaside.facebook.com, checked against a hash in the same publisher's release manifest. muse releases about daily, so the code that runs is not pinned. The launcher accepts only a channel (`muse-stable` or `muse-canary`), not a version, so the 2026-10-07 plan's "download a fixed version" cannot be met through the installer. The launcher also checks for updates hourly in the background unless `MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1`. The pin has a silent failure mode: if Meta edits install.sh, every muse install step fails and muse is recorded as not installed until someone updates the hash, with no alert. docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md still says muse is "installed unpinned", which is closer to the truth than the pin suggests.

Decision (owner, 2026-10-09). Remove the hash pin; do not pin a binary version.

Required change.
- Remove `MUSE_INSTALLER_SHA256` and its check from all four install steps. Keep the HTTPS-only download (`curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2`) to a file under `$RUNNER_TEMP`, then `bash` it.
- Set `MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` for every step that runs muse, so the binary cannot change during a run.
- Record the installed muse version in each muse attempt (for example `muse --version` in the install step and in the attempt's diagnostic), so each verdict can be traced to a binary.
- Docs: rewrite the muse sentence in docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md (Setup, `META_API_KEY` bullet) to say muse follows the `muse-stable` channel unpinned, what is exposed (the `META_API_KEY` secret and a read-only checkout of a public repository), and that the owner accepted this on 2026-10-05 and reconfirmed it on 2026-10-09. Add a dated note to _project/decisions/oracle-review-v2-shadow-2026-10-05.md recording that the installer hash pin was tried and removed, and why.

Out of scope. Muse subscription auth (`MUSE_AUTH_PATH`), the model choice, the reviewer order.

Guardrails.
- The workflow is a soundness path and very-high tier; the change needs an oracle success review.
- Do not change the claude or codex install pins.
- Worktree via `make worktree-create` and `make agent-write-preflight`; identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; explicit staging; no comments in workflow `run:` blocks beyond what comment-policy allows; `make comment-policy-check`.

Decision gate. If `MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` breaks the install or the run, stop and report rather than dropping it silently.
